The PR makes the Discord gateway supervisor call `emitter.off("error", onGatewayError)` during dispose and rewrites Discord monitor tests to assert zero retained error listeners after cleanup.

PR surface: Source +1, Tests -30. Total -29 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. for the review blocker: dispose the PR-head supervisor, then emit `error` on the same EventEmitter with no listeners; Node throws that error. The original leak concern is also source-reproducible because current main registers one supervisor listener and does not remove it on dispose.

target.title: fix(discord): prevent stale gateway error listeners after restart
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where restarting or reinitializing the Discord gateway supervisor could leave stale `error` listeners attached to the shared gateway emitter after the old supervisor was disposed.

## Why This Change Was Made

The supervisor already clears lifecycle state and pending events on dispose, but it also needs to detach the exact gateway `error` listener it registered during construction. This keeps teardown scoped to the old supervisor instance and avoids retaining old runtime closures across repeated gateway start/stop cycles.

## User Impact

Discord gateway restarts no longer accumulate obsolete error listeners from prior supervisor instances, reducing listener leak risk and preventing stale runtime state from observing later gateway errors.

## Evidence

- `changed-discord-monitor-tests` passed:

  ```text
  [test] starting test/vitest/vitest.extension-discord.config.ts
  The `envFile` option is deprecated, please use `envDir: false` instead.

   RUN  v4.1.9 [local path redacted]


   Test Files  2 passed (2)
        Tests  43 passed (43)
     Start at  19:28:45
     Duration  21.14s (transform 12.59s, setup 1.76s, import 10.23s, tests 10.67s, environment 0ms)

  [test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 33.36s
  ```

- `runtime-discord-supervisor-dispose-loop` passed:

  ```text
  discord gateway supervisor dispose loop leaves 0 error listeners after each stop
  ```

- `origin/main` was refreshed before the fix; the supervisor still registered `emitter.on("error", onGatewayError)` without removing it in `dispose()`.
- Open PR search for the same Discord gateway supervisor dispose/listener issue returned no matching open PRs.
